purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for storage bindings, record revisions, snapshots/checkpoints, audit/recovery evidence, backups and restore candidates/results.

owns: DWH Persistence and Recovery Monitor semantics

topics.name: DWH Persistence and Recovery Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor for storage bindings, record revisions, snapshots/checkpoints, audit/recovery evidence, backups and restore candidates/results.

semantics.identity_rule: Record, revision, storage binding, snapshot, backup and restore-execution identities remain distinct.
semantics.candidate_rule: Restore candidate is visibly distinct from accepted/live state.
semantics.action_rule: snapshot/backup/restore/rollback/migrate-storage operations invoke separate authorized canonical workflows.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing backup/recovery artifacts grants no restore or mutation authority.
semantics.trace_rule: Every backup/restore result retains exact source snapshot/target/integrity refs.
semantics.failure_rule: Inconsistent snapshots, integrity failures and partial recovery states are surfaced explicitly.

invariants.rule: Physical storage location, file name, engine page, snapshot artifact or backup copy never replaces canonical data/schema/instance identity; persistence and recovery operate on exact semantic identities with explicit version/provenance evidence.

hard_gates.condition: monitor conflates snapshot and live data

prose.summary: Define a read-only Expose monitor for storage bindings, record revisions, snapshots/checkpoints, audit/recovery evidence, backups and restore candidates/results.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against DWH mutation, runtime snapshot, repository acceptance and retention contracts.
